segments.an10.174:1.1: “Pāṇātipātampāhaṃ, bhikkhave, tividhaṃ vadāmi – lobhahetukampi, dosahetukampi, mohahetukampi.
segments.an10.174:2.1: “Adinnādānampāhaṃ, bhikkhave, tividhaṃ vadāmi – lobhahetukampi, dosahetukampi, mohahetukampi.
segments.an10.174:3.1: “Kāmesumicchācārampāhaṃ, bhikkhave, tividhaṃ vadāmi – lobhahetukampi, dosahetukampi, mohahetukampi.
segments.an10.174:4.1: “Musāvādampāhaṃ, bhikkhave, tividhaṃ vadāmi – lobhahetukampi, dosahetukampi, mohahetukampi.
segments.an10.174:5.1: “Pisuṇavācampāhaṃ, bhikkhave, tividhaṃ vadāmi – lobhahetukampi, dosahetukampi, mohahetukampi.
segments.an10.174:6.1: “Pharusavācampāhaṃ, bhikkhave, tividhaṃ vadāmi – lobhahetukampi, dosahetukampi, mohahetukampi.
segments.an10.174:7.1: “Samphappalāpampāhaṃ, bhikkhave, tividhaṃ vadāmi – lobhahetukampi, dosahetukampi, mohahetukampi.
segments.an10.174:8.1: “Abhijjhampāhaṃ, bhikkhave, tividhaṃ vadāmi – lobhahetukampi, dosahetukampi, mohahetukampi.
segments.an10.174:9.1: “Byāpādampāhaṃ, bhikkhave, tividhaṃ vadāmi – lobhahetukampi, dosahetukampi, mohahetukampi.
segments.an10.174:10.1: “Micchādiṭṭhimpāhaṃ, bhikkhave, tividhaṃ vadāmi – lobhahetukampi, dosahetukampi, mohahetukampi.
segments.an10.174:10.3: Iti kho, bhikkhave, lobho kammanidānasambhavo, doso kammanidānasambhavo, moho kammanidānasambhavo.
segments.an10.174:10.4: Lobhakkhayā kammanidānasaṅkhayo, dosakkhayā kammanidānasaṅkhayo, mohakkhayā kammanidānasaṅkhayo”ti.

lines: Aṭṭhame lobhahetukampīti pāṇātipātassa lobho upanissayakoṭiyā hetu hoti dosamohasampayuttopi.
